intent: Inspect alternative review and identity semantics before implementing additional forge adapters

sources.pattern: Independent peer-owned Git namespaces and P2P discovery; issues and patches replicated alongside Git code.
sources.limits: Radicle patch proposals are not identical to GitHub PRs; adapter must preserve peer identity and revision state.

sources.pattern: Comments, system notes and distinct label/state/milestone resource events need separate event adapters.
sources.limits: A notes-only projection omits resource state event history; pagination and confidential note constraints apply.

sources.pattern: Pull request activity includes approvals, requested changes and inline diff comments as distinct records.
sources.limits: Cloud and Data Center APIs are different; issue tracker availability and permissions must be rechecked.

sources.pattern: Model explicit PR to work-item links separately from repository refs and review comments.
sources.limits: Organization/project/repository scoping, permissions and Azure identity are not directly portable to Forgejo.

sources.pattern: Review objects have persistent Change-Id, patch-set revisions, label votes and diff-anchored review threads.
sources.limits: Do not flatten Gerrit multiple patch sets and review votes into a single GitHub PR body.
